context.reviewer_independent_take_on_point_4: Agree with ISSUE-FIXER and CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR: zero replacement coverage is correct here, not just acceptable. Checked this independently rather than deferring: the only structurally-checkable claim in the deleted test's intent ('no second ticker was added to application.ex') is already fully and permanently proven by the surviving sibling test (GenServer-count over lib/letflow/scheduler/**/*.ex) -- that IS the substantive property, expressed without depending on git history. The remaining half of the deleted test's title ('application.ex untouched') was never a real requirement; REQ-186's actual application.ex-adjacent AC (AC9, no route/controller) is separately and correctly covered elsewhere via a structural check. Adding a replacement assertion that scheduler_children/0 is exercised would require exporting a currently-private function with no REQ/AC backing that -- itself exactly the kind of ahead-of-need abstraction scope-creep check #4 should flag against, not something this fix should sneak in. Concur: no gap is being silently left open, and the forward-looking note in the design doc (section 7) correctly defers that to a future requirement rather than resolving it here.
context.wf03_step_numbering_nuance: Per WF-03's own step numbering this is Step 4 (TEST-DESIGNER, normally the fail-then-pass regression-proof step). Flagging explicitly: this issue IS the removal of an over-broad test with no replacement assertion -- there is no 'bug' left in application code to reproduce with a fail-then-pass test in the traditional sense (all the actual production-code work already exists and is already tested; nothing here needs a new failing-then-passing test to prove a fix). TEST-DESIGNER's job on this handoff should be to (a) confirm there is no missing regression-test need beyond what REVIEWER and the design doc already checked (the AC7/AC9 cross-check above), and (b) add a test ONLY if TEST-DESIGNER independently finds a real, currently-uncovered acceptance criterion or regression risk -- not to force an artificial 'reproduce ISS-0378's bug' test onto what is fundamentally a test-deletion issue. If TEST-DESIGNER agrees no test is warranted, route through to TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR with that finding stated explicitly rather than silently skipping the step.
